title: Ahead of its IPO, Anthropic’s Daniela Amodei shrugs off doubts about AI’s returns
brief: Anthropic's annualized revenue reached $47 billion in May, growing from $9 billion at end-2025, demonstrating rapid scaling ahead of the company's upcoming IPO. CEO Daniela Amodei dismissed concerns about AI's return on investment, signaling confidence in the business model's profitability despite industry skepticism about AI's long-term commercial viability.
